build.reason: The recipe compiles a quoted ares.h with only -I. and links the root .libs/libcares.a, while public headers and the Autotools library target have moved into include and src/lib. The fixed recipe contains no alternate include or link route.

input.reason: The entry forwards the fuzzer's bytes and size to every parser, allowing finite DNS reply inputs; the parser contracts accept a buffer and length.

lifecycle.reason: Each output pointer starts null and is freed after its call when nonnull. The hostent and data free functions accept the corresponding returned objects.

control_flow.reason: The entry calls all nine reply parsers in sequence and reaches the corresponding cleanup after each return. A and AAAA pass through the shared address parser, which validates the reply before producing results.

accepted.requirement: Compile the fuzz entry against the relocated public ares.h and generated headers using their actual include directories.
accepted.target_route: build.sh runs configure and make, then compiles test/ares-test-fuzz.c with -I. before linking the fuzz binary.
accepted.failure_condition: The entry includes "ares.h", while the new public-header build contract places ares.h under include; the compile command supplies no -Iinclude path.
accepted.alternative_paths: The complete target compile command supplies only -I.; neither the entry nor the recipe adds another include directory.

source_evidence.quote:
# what headers to install on 'make install':
include_HEADERS = ares.h ares_version.h ares_build.h ares_rules.h

EXTRA_DIST = ares_build.h.cmake ares_build.h.in ares_build.h.dist CMakeLists.txt

# Makefile.inc provides the CSOURCES and HHEADERS defines
include Makefile.inc

libcares_la_SOURCES = $(CSOURCES) $(HHEADERS)

# what headers to install on 'make install':
libcares_la_HEADERS = ares.h ares_version.h ares_dns.h \
	ares_build.h ares_rules.h

harness_evidence.quote:
# Build the project.
./buildconf
./configure --enable-debug
make clean
make -j$(nproc) V=1 all

# Build the fuzzers.
$CC $CFLAGS -I. -c $SRC/c-ares/test/ares-test-fuzz.c -o $WORK/ares-test-fuzz.o
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 $WORK/ares-test-fuzz.o \
    -o $OUT/ares_parse_reply_fuzzer \
    $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a

accepted.requirement: Link the fuzz binary with the archive produced by the relocated src/lib Autotools library target.
accepted.target_route: The recipe runs make all through generated subdirectory makefiles, then links $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a.
accepted.failure_condition: The library target is now in src/lib; the old root-level library target was removed, so the hard-coded root .libs archive path does not identify its output.
accepted.alternative_paths: The complete link command names one hard-coded archive and contains no search path or second library route.
